'''Withered bones''' are items found in [[Muddy Scrap Pile]]s in [[Sunken Crypts]] and in [[Chest]]s in the [[Swamp]] [[Biomes|biome]].

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
* {{item link|Nimble Anklet}}

=== Summoning ===
A total of ten Withered bones are required to summon the third boss, [[Bonemass]]. See [[Forsaken Altars]].
